content.value: Consider a rectangular plate of $6 0 \times 5 0$ cm with one surface insulated and other surface maintained at uniform temperature of ${ 8 8 ^ { \circ } C }$ which is placed in a quiescent air at atmospheric pressure and at $2 2 ^ { \circ } C .$ Calculate the average heat transfer coefficient, if the plate is inclined at $6 9 ^ { \circ }$ and the hot surface faces upward.
